item.title: 2 minors drown in Dhansiri river
item.description: Three minor boys from Naharbari Ward No. 10 were returning home after attending tuition when they decided to swim in the Dhansiri River.

item.title: Sharkaphung Shooting: Two Civilians Injured, TNFO Demands Security Reinforcement
item.description: Two civilians, Rinyui Ramror (41) and Raichan Lungleng (24), were reportedly shot by suspected Kuki militants at Sharkaphung village under Litan Police Station, Kamjong District. The incident occurred around 9:30 AM while the victims were in the Pastor’s Quarter. Both sustained gunshot wounds—Ramror to the thigh and Lungleng to the leg—and are in critical condition.

item.title: RCB to Keep 11 Seats Empty at Chinnaswamy Stadium in Memory of Stampede Victims
item.description: RCB CEO Rajesh Menon announced that 11 seats at M. item.title: Pakistan: 15-Year-Old Hindu Girl Abducted in Sindh, Rights Group Warns of Rising Minority Violence
item.description: The Voice of Pakistan Minority (VOPM) reported the abduction of Miran Meghwar, 15, from her home in Mirpurkhas, Sindh, allegedly by Tariq Kauri and Allah Dino Kauri. Despite a police case being registered, her whereabouts remain unknown. The Meghwar family has appealed for urgent action, with community members rallying in support and demanding justice. VOPM
